name: Komiya Chigusa
source:
[url=/c124681]Chie[/url]'s older brother who is currently in a coma.

He was the favorite child of his family and therefore treated much better than Chie was. It's clear he always disapproved of how his parents treated his younger sister. As such, he always was there for her and tried to encourage her to follow her heart.

[Edited from [url=https://wolf-game.fandom.com/wiki/Chigusa_Komiya]Wolf Game Wiki[/url]]
